digest.component_or_area: code-review gate and model class resolution plumbing
propositions: The code-review gate's base, round_a, round_b, and coach steps inherit cfg.model implicitly rather than declaring per-pass model classes, causing all four steps to use the same model regardless of provider configuration.
When cfg.model is a bare claude-* id on a non-default provider, steps without explicit model declarations resolve to direct Anthropic instead of the configured provider's corresponding model class.

The code-review gate lacks per-step model declarations for Pass-1 (base, round_a, round_b) and Pass-4 (coach), while Pass-2 (verify) alone declares model: standard; this prevents expressing the operator requirement of opus-family for Pass-1 and sonnet-family for Pass-2/Pass-4 on non-default providers.

Batch steps (round_a, round_b) cannot receive per-step model declarations via model: key because the batch runner path reads only batch.model_ladder and silently discards the enclosing step's model key.
The runtime execution does not honor per-step model declarations in the code-review gate YAML, even when present, causing the plumbing defect to mask configuration correctness at the YAML level.
